# Repository rules (must follow)

## Versioning & Changelog (MANDATORY)
- If you change any code, you MUST run: ./scripts/bump-version.sh
- ./scripts/bump-version.sh is the single source of truth for:
  - version numbers across the repo
  - CHANGELOG updates
- If changes do not require a version bump, explicitly state why in the PR description.

## PR acceptance criteria
- CI must pass.
- PR must include:
  - updated versions (as produced by bump-version.sh)
  - updated CHANGELOG entry

## PR title format (MANDATORY)
- PR titles generated by Copilot **must** follow Conventional Commits format:
  - `<type>(optional-scope): short description`
  - Type must be lowercase: `feat`, `fix`, `update`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`, `revert`
  - Scope (if used) must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores: `[a-z0-9_-]+`
- **CI enforcement**: The commit-lint workflow will **reject** PR titles from Copilot that contain:
  - **Generic automation phrases**: "Codex pull request", "Copilot updates", "AI-generated changes", "autogenerated fix"
  - **Vague phrases**: "update code", "fix issue", "apply changes", "make changes" (complete phrases)
  - **Standalone vague words**: "update", "fix", "change" when used alone as the entire description
- Examples of **good** titles:
  - `feat(installer): add validation for preserved kernels`
  - `fix(ci): handle empty PR title from automation`
  - `docs: clarify ROCm prerequisites`
  - `feat(rocm): add ROCm 7.1 support`
  - `docs: update codebase documentation` (specific context provided)
- Examples of **bad** titles (will be rejected):
  - `fix: Codex-generated pull request` (generic automation phrase)
  - `feat: Copilot updates` (generic automation phrase)
  - `feat: update code` (vague phrase)
  - `update: fix issue` (vague phrase)
  - `docs: update` (standalone vague word)
  - `FEAT: uppercase type` (wrong case)
